articles.title: Neon Glow
articles.summary: Near-black surface with a faint fine gold and amber speckle, subtle warm glint rather than a glow. A dark car with a faint gold-and-violet dotted sparkle in diagonal streaks; reads as black with a fine amber shimmer.
articles.what: Bright neon tube edge-glow effect casting vivid colored light against the surface Up close: Near-black charcoal with thin amber-yellow and purple squiggles, tiny knots, loops and circles, strung in diagonal rows from top-left to bottom-right like glowing wire doodles or circuit scribbles. Lines are 1-3 px wide, motifs 10-30 px; there are no large shapes and no actual glow halo. From a distance: A dark car with a faint gold-and-violet dotted sparkle in diagonal streaks; reads as black with a fine amber shimmer. Measured spec (average): metal 84, roughness 75, coat 51. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
when: Fits: gt / sports car, show car, stock car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Neon Glow" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof and quarters: wide panels show the diagonal flow
Doors: diagonal direction suggests motion
Dark ground: white, yellow or neon numbers read; thin gold ones mix with the squiggles, so use a thick outline.
Big bold stripes and blocks in white or neon: the fine scribble sits quietly under them
Pairs well with: gold trim, matte black, deep red, chrome.
pitfalls: Not a glowing neon tube: no bright halo or colour bleed, only thin yellow and violet scribbles
Not a clean gloss black: the ground is textured with fine lines
Avoid: big dark areas in the sim, next to loud neon finishes.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 84 (pearl-level metal), roughness 75 (satin gloss), clearcoat 51 (strong-to-medium clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: big dark areas in the sim, next to loud neon finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: big bold stripes and blocks in white or neon: the fine scribble sits quietly under them; thick outline lettering: stays readable on the dark ground
Patterns to avoid: fine circuit, carbon or dot patterns: same scale, muddy; other neon or sparkle finishes: lines get lost
Spec overlays that work: gloss/matte stripes: add glossy strips on the black; coarser flake: adds more sparkle on top
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
